name: May-chan
source:
A young man working at a firm contemplates this existence; a young boy shares a friendship with a odd girl. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20092]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一名在公司工作的年輕人思索著自身的存在；一個男孩與一名古怪的女孩成為朋友。
